<script>
// When the user scrolls down 2px from the top of the document, resize the navbar's padding and the logo's font size
window.onscroll = function() { scrollFunction() };

function scrollFunction() {
    const header = document.getElementById("header-widget-area");
    const logo = document.getElementById("header-logo-aw");

    if (window.innerWidth > 1024) {
        if (document.body.scrollTop > 2 || document.documentElement.scrollTop > 2) {
            header.style.transform = "translate(0, -87px)";
            header.classList.add("aw-blur-active");
            logo.style.transform = "translate(0, 57px)";
        } else {
            header.style.transform = "translate(0, 0)";
            header.classList.remove("aw-blur-active");
            logo.style.transform = "translate(0, 0)";
        }
    }
}

window.onresize = function() { resizeFunction() };

function resizeFunction() {
    const header = document.getElementById("header-widget-area");
    const logo = document.getElementById("header-logo-aw");

    if (window.innerWidth <= 1024) {
        header.style.transform = "translate(0, 0)";
        header.classList.remove("aw-blur-active");
        logo.style.transform = "translate(0, 0)";
    }
}
</script>

/* BUttons */
/* ===== Dark Blue Button ===== */

.aurora-btn--dark-blue a.elementor-button {
    position: relative;
    z-index: 1;
    border-radius: 4px;
    font-weight: 600;

    background: transparent !important;
    color: #121C42 !important;
    border: 2px solid #121C42 !important;

    transition:
        transform 0.35s linear,
        box-shadow 0.35s linear,
        background-position 0.35s linear;
}

/* Hover gradient layer - same as White Button */
.aurora-btn--dark-blue a.elementor-button:before {
    content: "";
    position: absolute;
    inset: -1px;
    border-radius: 4px;
    background: linear-gradient(99deg, #47fffa, #0066ff);
    opacity: 0;
    transition: opacity 0.35s linear;
    z-index: -1;
}

/* Glow - same as White Button */
.aurora-btn--dark-blue .elementor-button-wrapper:after {
    content: "";
    position: absolute;
    inset: -5px;
    border-radius: 4px;
    pointer-events: none;
    z-index: 0;

    background: linear-gradient(-99deg, #47FFFA, #0066ff);
    background-size: 300% 300%;
    filter: blur(20px);

    opacity: 0;
    mix-blend-mode: screen;
    animation: none;

    transition:
        opacity 0.35s linear,
        filter 0.35s linear;
}

/* Hover */
.aurora-btn--dark-blue a.elementor-button:hover {
    text-decoration: none;
    transform: translateY(-2px);

    /* Same hover effect as white button */
    background-position: 100% 0;

window.onscroll = function() { scrollFunction() };

function scrollFunction() {
    const header = document.getElementById("header-widget-area");
    const logo = document.getElementById("header-logo-aw");

    if (window.innerWidth > 1024) {
        if (document.body.scrollTop > 2 || document.documentElement.scrollTop > 2) {
            header.style.transform = "translate(0, -87px)";
            header.classList.add("aw-blur-active");
            logo.style.transform = "translate(0, 57px)";
        } else {
            header.style.transform = "translate(0, 0)";
            header.classList.remove("aw-blur-active");
            logo.style.transform = "translate(0, 0)";
        }
    }
}

window.onresize = function() { resizeFunction() };

function resizeFunction() {
    const header = document.getElementById("header-widget-area");
    const logo = document.getElementById("header-logo-aw");

    if (window.innerWidth <= 1024) {
        header.style.transform = "translate(0, 0)";
        header.classList.remove("aw-blur-active");
        logo.style.transform = "translate(0, 0)";
    }
}

/* BUttons */
/* ===== Dark Blue Button ===== */

.aurora-btn--dark-blue a.elementor-button {
    position: relative;
    z-index: 1;
    border-radius: 4px;
    font-weight: 600;

    background: transparent !important;
    color: #121C42 !important;
    border: 2px solid #121C42 !important;

    transition:
        transform 0.35s linear,
        box-shadow 0.35s linear,
        background-position 0.35s linear;
}

/* Hover gradient layer - same as White Button */
.aurora-btn--dark-blue a.elementor-button:before {
    content: "";
    position: absolute;
    inset: -1px;
    border-radius: 4px;
    background: linear-gradient(99deg, #47fffa, #0066ff);
    opacity: 0;
    transition: opacity 0.35s linear;
    z-index: -1;
}

/* Glow - same as White Button */
.aurora-btn--dark-blue .elementor-button-wrapper:after {
    content: "";
    position: absolute;
    inset: -5px;
    border-radius: 4px;
    pointer-events: none;
    z-index: 0;

    background: linear-gradient(-99deg, #47FFFA, #0066ff);
    background-size: 300% 300%;
    filter: blur(20px);

    opacity: 0;
    mix-blend-mode: screen;
    animation: none;

    transition:
        opacity 0.35s linear,
        filter 0.35s linear;
}

/* Hover */
.aurora-btn--dark-blue a.elementor-button:hover {
    text-decoration: none;
    transform: translateY(-2px);

    /* Same hover effect as white button */
    background-position: 100% 0;

    color: #090f24 !important;

    /* Border disappears into gradient */
    border-color: transparent !important;

    box-shadow:
        0 2px 1px rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.05),
        0 4px 2px rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.05),
        0 8px 4px rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.05),
        0 16px 8px rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.05),
        0 32px 16px rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.05);
}

/* Show gradient */
.aurora-btn--dark-blue a.elementor-button:hover:before {
    opacity: 1;
}

/* Show glow */
.aurora-btn--dark-blue .elementor-button-wrapper:hover:after {
    opacity: 0.6;
    filter: blur(20px);
}/* End custom CSS */

/* BUttons */
/* ===== Dark Blue Button ===== */

.aurora-btn--dark-blue a.elementor-button {
    position: relative;
    z-index: 1;
    border-radius: 4px;
    font-weight: 600;

    background: transparent !important;
    color: #121C42 !important;
    border: 2px solid #121C42 !important;

    transition:
        transform 0.35s linear,
        box-shadow 0.35s linear,
        background-position 0.35s linear;
}

/* Hover gradient layer - same as White Button */
.aurora-btn--dark-blue a.elementor-button:before {
    content: "";
    position: absolute;
    inset: -1px;
    border-radius: 4px;
    background: linear-gradient(99deg, #47fffa, #0066ff);
    opacity: 0;
    transition: opacity 0.35s linear;
    z-index: -1;
}

/* Glow - same as White Button */
.aurora-btn--dark-blue .elementor-button-wrapper:after {
    content: "";
    position: absolute;
    inset: -5px;
    border-radius: 4px;
    pointer-events: none;
    z-index: 0;

    background: linear-gradient(-99deg, #47FFFA, #0066ff);
    background-size: 300% 300%;
    filter: blur(20px);

    opacity: 0;
    mix-blend-mode: screen;
    animation: none;

    transition:
        opacity 0.35s linear,
        filter 0.35s linear;
}

/* Hover */
.aurora-btn--dark-blue a.elementor-button:hover {
    text-decoration: none;
    transform: translateY(-2px);

    /* Same hover effect as white button */
    background-position: 100% 0;

    color: #090f24 !important;

    /* Border disappears into gradient */
    border-color: transparent !important;

    box-shadow:
        0 2px 1px rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.05),
        0 4px 2px rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.05),
        0 8px 4px rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.05),
        0 16px 8px rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.05),
        0 32px 16px rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.05);
}

/* Show gradient */
.aurora-btn--dark-blue a.elementor-button:hover:before {
    opacity: 1;
}

/* Show glow */
.aurora-btn--dark-blue .elementor-button-wrapper:hover:after {
    opacity: 0.6;
    filter: blur(20px);
}/* End custom CSS */

window.onscroll = function() { scrollFunction() };

function scrollFunction() {
    const header = document.getElementById("header-widget-area");
    const logo = document.getElementById("header-logo-aw");

    if (window.innerWidth > 1024) {
        if (document.body.scrollTop > 2 || document.documentElement.scrollTop > 2) {
            header.style.transform = "translate(0, -87px)";
            header.classList.add("aw-blur-active");
            logo.style.transform = "translate(0, 57px)";
        } else {
            header.style.transform = "translate(0, 0)";
            header.classList.remove("aw-blur-active");
            logo.style.transform = "translate(0, 0)";
        }
    }
}

window.onresize = function() { resizeFunction() };

function resizeFunction() {
    const header = document.getElementById("header-widget-area");
    const logo = document.getElementById("header-logo-aw");

    if (window.innerWidth <= 1024) {
        header.style.transform = "translate(0, 0)";
        header.classList.remove("aw-blur-active");
        logo.style.transform = "translate(0, 0)";
    }
}

/* BUttons */
/* ===== Dark Blue Button ===== */

.aurora-btn--dark-blue a.elementor-button {
    position: relative;
    z-index: 1;
    border-radius: 4px;
    font-weight: 600;

    background: transparent !important;
    color: #121C42 !important;
    border: 2px solid #121C42 !important;

    transition:
        transform 0.35s linear,
        box-shadow 0.35s linear,
        background-position 0.35s linear;
}

/* Hover gradient layer - same as White Button */
.aurora-btn--dark-blue a.elementor-button:before {
    content: "";
    position: absolute;
    inset: -1px;
    border-radius: 4px;
    background: linear-gradient(99deg, #47fffa, #0066ff);
    opacity: 0;
    transition: opacity 0.35s linear;
    z-index: -1;
}

/* Glow - same as White Button */
.aurora-btn--dark-blue .elementor-button-wrapper:after {
    content: "";
    position: absolute;
    inset: -5px;
    border-radius: 4px;
    pointer-events: none;
    z-index: 0;

    background: linear-gradient(-99deg, #47FFFA, #0066ff);
    background-size: 300% 300%;
    filter: blur(20px);

    opacity: 0;
    mix-blend-mode: screen;
    animation: none;

    transition:
        opacity 0.35s linear,
        filter 0.35s linear;
}

/* Hover */
.aurora-btn--dark-blue a.elementor-button:hover {
    text-decoration: none;
    transform: translateY(-2px);

    /* Same hover effect as white button */
    background-position: 100% 0;

    color: #090f24 !important;

    /* Border disappears into gradient */
    border-color: transparent !important;

    box-shadow:
        0 2px 1px rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.05),
        0 4px 2px rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.05),
        0 8px 4px rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.05),
        0 16px 8px rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.05),
        0 32px 16px rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.05);
}

/* Show gradient */
.aurora-btn--dark-blue a.elementor-button:hover:before {
    opacity: 1;
}

/* Show glow */
.aurora-btn--dark-blue .elementor-button-wrapper:hover:after {
    opacity: 0.6;
    filter: blur(20px);
}/* End custom CSS */

function scrollFunction() {
    const header = document.getElementById("header-widget-area");
    const logo = document.getElementById("header-logo-aw");

    if (window.innerWidth > 1024) {

        }
    }
}

window.onresize = function() { resizeFunction() };

function resizeFunction() {
    const header = document.getElementById("header-widget-area");

/* BUttons */
/* ===== Dark Blue Button ===== */

.aurora-btn--dark-blue a.elementor-button {
    position: relative;
    z-index: 1;
    border-radius: 4px;
    font-weight: 600;

    background: transparent !important;
    color: #121C42 !important;
    border: 2px solid #121C42 !important;

    transition:
        transform 0.35s linear,
        box-shadow 0.35s linear,
        background-position 0.35s linear;
}

/* Hover gradient layer - same as White Button */
.aurora-btn--dark-blue a.elementor-button:before {
    content: "";
    position: absolute;
    inset: -1px;
    border-radius: 4px;
    background: linear-gradient(99deg, #47fffa, #0066ff);
    opacity: 0;
    transition: opacity 0.35s linear;
    z-index: -1;
}

/* Glow - same as White Button */
.aurora-btn--dark-blue .elementor-button-wrapper:after {
    content: "";
    position: absolute;
    inset: -5px;
    border-radius: 4px;
    pointer-events: none;
    z-index: 0;

    background: linear-gradient(-99deg, #47FFFA, #0066ff);
    background-size: 300% 300%;
    filter: blur(20px);

    opacity: 0;
    mix-blend-mode: screen;
    animation: none;

    transition:
        opacity 0.35s linear,
        filter 0.35s linear;
}

/* Hover */
.aurora-btn--dark-blue a.elementor-button:hover {
    text-decoration: none;
    transform: translateY(-2px);

    /* Same hover effect as white button */
    background-position: 100% 0;

    color: #090f24 !important;

    /* Border disappears into gradient */
    border-color: transparent !important;

    box-shadow:
        0 2px 1px rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.05),
        0 4px 2px rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.05),
        0 8px 4px rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.05),
        0 16px 8px rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.05),
        0 32px 16px rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.05);
}

/* Show gradient */
.aurora-btn--dark-blue a.elementor-button:hover:before {
    opacity: 1;
}

/* Show glow */
.aurora-btn--dark-blue .elementor-button-wrapper:hover:after {
    opacity: 0.6;
    filter: blur(20px);
}/* End custom CSS */

// When the user scrolls down 2px from the top of the document, resize the navbar's padding and the logo's font size
window.onscroll = function() { scrollFunction() };

function scrollFunction() {
    const header = document.getElementById("header-widget-area");
    const logo = document.getElementById("header-logo-aw");

    if (window.innerWidth > 1024) {
        if (document.body.scrollTop > 2 || document.documentElement.scrollTop > 2) {
            header.style.transform = "translate(0, -87px)";
            header.classList.add("aw-blur-active");
            logo.style.transform = "translate(0, 57px)";
        } else {
            header.style.transform = "translate(0, 0)";
            header.classList.remove("aw-blur-active");
            logo.style.transform = "translate(0, 0)";
        }
    }
}

window.onresize = function() { resizeFunction() };

function resizeFunction() {
    const header = document.getElementById("header-widget-area");
    const logo = document.getElementById("header-logo-aw");

    if (window.innerWidth <= 1024) {
        header.style.transform = "translate(0, 0)";
        header.classList.remove("aw-blur-active");
        logo.style.transform = "translate(0, 0)";
    }
}

/* BUttons */
/* ===== Dark Blue Button ===== */

.aurora-btn--dark-blue a.elementor-button {
    position: relative;
    z-index: 1;
    border-radius: 4px;
    font-weight: 600;

    background: transparent !important;
    color: #121C42 !important;
    border: 2px solid #121C42 !important;

    transition:
        transform 0.35s linear,
        box-shadow 0.35s linear,
        background-position 0.35s linear;
}

/* Hover gradient layer - same as White Button */
.aurora-btn--dark-blue a.elementor-button:before {
    content: "";
    position: absolute;
    inset: -1px;
    border-radius: 4px;
    background: linear-gradient(99deg, #47fffa, #0066ff);
    opacity: 0;
    transition: opacity 0.35s linear;
    z-index: -1;
}

/* Glow - same as White Button */
.aurora-btn--dark-blue .elementor-button-wrapper:after {
    content: "";
    position: absolute;
    inset: -5px;
    border-radius: 4px;
    pointer-events: none;
    z-index: 0;

    background: linear-gradient(-99deg, #47FFFA, #0066ff);
    background-size: 300% 300%;
    filter: blur(20px);

    opacity: 0;
    mix-blend-mode: screen;
    animation: none;

    transition:
        opacity 0.35s linear,
        filter 0.35s linear;
}

/* Hover */
.aurora-btn--dark-blue a.elementor-button:hover {
    text-decoration: none;
    transform: translateY(-2px);

    /* Same hover effect as white button */
    background-position: 100% 0;

    color: #090f24 !important;

    /* Border disappears into gradient */
    border-color: transparent !important;

    box-shadow:
        0 2px 1px rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.05),
        0 4px 2px rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.05),
        0 8px 4px rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.05),
        0 16px 8px rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.05),
        0 32px 16px rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.05);
}

/* Show gradient */
.aurora-btn--dark-blue a.elementor-button:hover:before {
    opacity: 1;
}

/* Show glow */
.aurora-btn--dark-blue .elementor-button-wrapper:hover:after {
    opacity: 0.6;
    filter: blur(20px);
}/* End custom CSS */

// When the user scrolls down 2px from the top of the document, resize the navbar's padding and the logo's font size
window.onscroll = function() { scrollFunction() };

function scrollFunction() {
    const header = document.getElementById("header-widget-area");
    const logo = document.getElementById("header-logo-aw");

    if (window.innerWidth > 1024) {
        if (document.body.scrollTop > 2 || document.documentElement.scrollTop > 2) {
            header.style.transform = "translate(0, -87px)";
            header.classList.add("aw-blur-active");
            logo.style.transform = "translate(0, 57px)";
        } else {
            header.style.transform = "translate(0, 0)";
            header.classList.remove("aw-blur-active");
            logo.style.transform = "translate(0, 0)";
        }
    }
}

window.onresize = function() { resizeFunction() };

function resizeFunction() {
    const header = document.getElementById("header-widget-area");
    const logo = document.getElementById("header-logo-aw");

    if (window.innerWidth <= 1024) {
        header.style.transform = "translate(0, 0)";
        header.classList.remove("aw-blur-active");
        logo.style.transform = "translate(0, 0)";
    }
}
</script>

/* BUttons */
/* ===== Dark Blue Button ===== */

.aurora-btn--dark-blue a.elementor-button {
    position: relative;
    z-index: 1;
    border-radius: 4px;
    font-weight: 600;

    background: transparent !important;
    color: #121C42 !important;
    border: 2px solid #121C42 !important;

    transition:
        transform 0.35s linear,
        box-shadow 0.35s linear,
        background-position 0.35s linear;
}

/* Hover gradient layer - same as White Button */
.aurora-btn--dark-blue a.elementor-button:before {
    content: "";
    position: absolute;
    inset: -1px;
    border-radius: 4px;
    background: linear-gradient(99deg, #47fffa, #0066ff);
    opacity: 0;
    transition: opacity 0.35s linear;
    z-index: -1;
}

/* Glow - same as White Button */
.aurora-btn--dark-blue .elementor-button-wrapper:after {
    content: "";
    position: absolute;
    inset: -5px;
    border-radius: 4px;
    pointer-events: none;
    z-index: 0;

    background: linear-gradient(-99deg, #47FFFA, #0066ff);
    background-size: 300% 300%;
    filter: blur(20px);

    opacity: 0;
    mix-blend-mode: screen;
    animation: none;

    transition:
        opacity 0.35s linear,
        filter 0.35s linear;
}

/* Hover */
.aurora-btn--dark-blue a.elementor-button:hover {
    text-decoration: none;
    transform: translateY(-2px);

    /* Same hover effect as white button */
    background-position: 100% 0;

    color: #090f24 !important;

    /* Border disappears into gradient */
    border-color: transparent !important;

    box-shadow:
        0 2px 1px rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.05),
        0 4px 2px rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.05),
        0 8px 4px rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.05),
        0 16px 8px rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.05),
        0 32px 16px rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.05);
}

/* Show gradient */
.aurora-btn--dark-blue a.elementor-button:hover:before {
    opacity: 1;
}

/* Show glow */
.aurora-btn--dark-blue .elementor-button-wrapper:hover:after {
    opacity: 0.6;
    filter: blur(20px);
}/* End custom CSS */
